node.statement: Because 0<=L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R, every defining inequality of an L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra remains true with epsilon_R: the product, associator, and approximate-unit upper bounds only increase; the C*-lower coefficient 1-epsilon only decreases; and the exact involution requirements are unchanged. Applying this at every matrix amplification, as required by def-extended-epsilon-cstar-algebra and def-epsilon-cstar-algebra, shows A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra. Hence epsilon_R is a legitimate target ambient record, not merely a label.
